mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sources (id, organization_id, project_id, task_id, kind, scope, status, display_name, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, blob_key, external_locator, origin, previous_source_id, metadata, created_by) SELECT #{id}, p.organization_id, p.id, #{taskId}, #{kind}, #{scope}, #{status}, #{displayName}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{blobKey}, #{externalLocator}, #{origin, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{previousSourceId}, #{metadata, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{createdBy} FROM projects p WHERE p.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND p.id = #{projectId} AND (#{taskId}::text IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tasks t WHERE t.organization_id = p.organization_id AND t.project_id = p.id AND t.id = #{taskId})) AND (#{previousSourceId}::text IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sources previous WHERE previous.organization_id = p.organization_id AND previous.project_id = p.id AND previous.id = #{previousSourceId}))
